concerns.text: Task T013 amends FR‑001 to make external dataset ingestion conditional (“only if a schema‑matching dataset is found”) whereas the original specification (FR‑001) required mandatory ingestion of public NIST/UCI/OpenML datasets. This constitutes a weakening of a functional requirement without documented stakeholder approval.

Task T013 also amends FR‑006/FR‑007 and SC‑001/SC‑003 to make bootstrap mediation conditional on acquiring a real dataset with ≥ 50 measured‑stress rows. The original functional requirements mandated mediation analysis (FR‑006) and its associated success criteria (SC‑001, SC‑003) unconditionally. Making them optional weakens the specification.

Task T013 replaces the linear proxy formula required by FR‑003 with a non‑linear proxy (`k·log(heat_input+1)·sqrt(cooling_rate)`). This changes the functional requirement’s exact specification, effectively weakening the original FR‑003 which explicitly prescribed the linear form.

Task T008 records mediation eligibility and may set `eligible: false`, leading to the mediation step being skipped (via T009). Because the original SC‑001 (proportion of variance mediated) and SC‑003 (bootstrap confidence intervals) depend on mediation being performed, skipping mediation leaves these success criteria unmeasured, violating the original success‑criterion contract.

Task T009 implements a hard skip of the bootstrap mediation analysis when eligibility is false, which can result in SC‑001 and SC‑003 remaining unfulfilled. This is a retroactive narrowing of the analysis scope not reflected in the original specification.
